suggestedProfile.notes: This style centers on minimalist, relaxed tailoring built around oversized blazers, high-waisted trousers or jeans, and a neutral palette of camel, black, and white. A minor romantic cottagecore direction also appears through a floral puff-sleeve dress accented with a ribbon hair bow. While your notes emphasize comfortable outfits for walking, the inspiration images focus on structured suiting and a flowy dress without showing footwear, blending polished silhouettes with a preference for everyday ease.

observations.detail: oversized blazer; cropped bandeau top; high-waisted straight-leg jeans. No footwear is worn. The blazer appears to be a soft, lightweight woven fabric, the bandeau top appears to be smocked or ribbed, and the jeans appear to be mid-weight denim.

oversized blazer; high-waisted tailored trousers; thin string bracelet. Cropped below the upper thighs, so trouser hems and footwear are not visible. The suiting appears to be a smooth mid-weight woven fabric with a relaxed fit.

double-breasted blazer; fitted crew-neck crop top; high-waisted pleated trousers; self-fabric waist belt; small hoop earrings. Cropped at mid-thigh, so lower trousers and footwear are not visible. The suiting appears to be a light-to-midweight woven fabric and the top appears to be cotton jersey.

floral midi or maxi dress; ribbon hair bow; possibly a delicate pendant necklace. The lower dress hem and footwear are obscured by tall grass. The dress appears to be made of a lightweight woven cotton or linen fabric.
